prompts.name: start
prompts.description: Orient and start working in this project.
prompts.body:
You are working in **kimi-claw** (`library`, `javascript`).

First call `kimi_overview` — it is the canonical map of this server's tools, plugins and a `recommendedNextAction`. Follow the recommendation.

## Project shape

- Type: `library`
- Framework: _(none detected)_
- Monorepo tool: _(none)_
- Test runner: `unknown`
- Package manager: `npm`

## Quality gates

- `test` → `node --experimental-transform-types --test tests/*.test.ts`
- `build` → `npm run build:internal`
- `clean` → `rm -rf dist`
- `build:internal` → `npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p dist/src && cp src/message-filter.js dist/src/message-filter.js && npm run minify:release`
- `build:public` → `npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p dist/src && cp src/message-filter.js dist/src/message-filter.js && npm run minify:release`
- `minify:release` → `for file in $(find dist -type f -name '*.js'); do terser "$file" --compress passes=2,dead_code=true,drop_console=true,drop_debugger=true --mangle --format comments=false --output "$file" -- "$file"; done`
- `generate:im-proto` → `node scripts/generate-im-proto.mjs`
- `refresh:im-proto` → `node scripts/refresh-im-proto.mjs`
- `refresh:im-proto:check` → `node scripts/refresh-im-proto.mjs --check`
- `check:active-surface` → `node scripts/check-active-im-surface.mjs`
- `test:cases` → `node --experimental-transform-types tests/acp-case-runner.ts`
- `test:coverage:baseline` → `node --experimental-transform-types --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='src/**/*.ts' --test tests/*.test.ts`

## When you change the project

1. Re-run `kimi_analyze_project` to refresh the analysis.
2. If the project grew (new scripts, new framework deps, new monorepo packages), call `kimi_plan_mcp_project` to refresh the blueprint and `kimi_create_project` to materialise the new tools.
3. Never invent tool names; only call what `overview` lists.

prompts.name: fix quality
prompts.description: Run the gates and fix what fails.
prompts.body:
Run the project quality gates in this order and fix what fails:
1. `test` → `node --experimental-transform-types --test tests/*.test.ts`
1. `build` → `npm run build:internal`
1. `clean` → `rm -rf dist`
1. `build:internal` → `npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p dist/src && cp src/message-filter.js dist/src/message-filter.js && npm run minify:release`
1. `build:public` → `npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p dist/src && cp src/message-filter.js dist/src/message-filter.js && npm run minify:release`
1. `minify:release` → `for file in $(find dist -type f -name '*.js'); do terser "$file" --compress passes=2,dead_code=true,drop_console=true,drop_debugger=true --mangle --format comments=false --output "$file" -- "$file"; done`
1. `generate:im-proto` → `node scripts/generate-im-proto.mjs`
1. `refresh:im-proto` → `node scripts/refresh-im-proto.mjs`
1. `refresh:im-proto:check` → `node scripts/refresh-im-proto.mjs --check`
1. `check:active-surface` → `node scripts/check-active-im-surface.mjs`
1. `test:cases` → `node --experimental-transform-types tests/acp-case-runner.ts`
1. `test:coverage:baseline` → `node --experimental-transform-types --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='src/**/*.ts' --test tests/*.test.ts`

If a gate is broken because of an external dep (downstream service, network, missing env), record it as `external-gate-blocker` with the evidence and continue.
